# watchpoint_monitor_group_member (Resource)

Membership of a single monitor in a monitor group. This resource has no update endpoint; any change recreates the membership. The id is `<group_id>/<monitor_id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_monitor_group_member" "example" {
  group_id     = "grp_001"
  monitor_id   = "mon_abc123"
  monitor_type = "HttpApi"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Monitor group to add the monitor to.
- `monitor_id` (String) Monitor to add to the group.
- `monitor_type` (String) Monitor type (e.g. `HttpApi`, `Ssl`, `Dns`, `Tcp`, `Ping`, `Synthetic`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic membership ID, `<group_id>/<monitor_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_monitor_group_member.example grp_001/mon_abc123
```
